faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Sherman Oaks?

faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Sherman Oaks rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.
